Lina: Morning team — quick Day-0 checklist for cloud marketplace onboarding. what must be shipped today?
Raj: Publisher account verified. need SKU -> internal product mapping, pricing tiers, and a short trial note.
Marta: Legal needs final EULA + DPA variants per region (EU/UK) and a short privacy blurb.
Ethan: Infra items: IAM role for ingest (will share ARN), staging bucket, AMI/OCI IDs, and artifact signing key (KMS).
Sophie: I'll package the bundle (container image + launch scripts + manifest). can someone paste the minimal manifest fields?
Lina: minimal manifest: product_name, version, artifacts (type+id/uri), pricing.sku, and supported_regions. keep it lean.
Sophie: copying example manifest:
```json
{
  "product_name": "Redwood Inference - Dedicated",
  "version": "2026.03.21",
  "artifacts": [ { "type": "ami", "id": "ami-0a1b2c3d4e" }, { "type": "container", "uri": "gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026-03-21" } ],
  "pricing": { "sku": "RWI-DED-MONTHLY", "tier": "monthly", "price_usd": "4999" },
  "supported_regions": ["aws-us-east-1","gcp-europe-west1","azure-eastus2"]
}
```
Marta: add legal note line: "Publisher does not retain customer content; telemetry is aggregated and pseudonymized." I'll draft EU/UK EULA snippets and attach.
Raj: AWS/GCP/Azure require different SKU attributes. I'll map and post CSV by 1600 PT.
Ethan: deploy-bot: created bucket redwood-mkp-staging-1799, role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/marketplace-ingest-role
deploy-bot: upload accepted redwood-inference-2026.tar.gz sha256:fa34...
Sophie: uploading signed bundle now. it will include: manifest.json, CHANGES.md, LICENSE, launch.sh, deploy.yaml.
Lina: QA: can we run smoke installs in three regions? boot, auth (publisher creds), run sample inference. small pass/fail matrix.
Raj: QA matrix confirmed: aws-us-east-1, gcp-europe-west1, azure-eastus2. I'll coordinate test windows.
Marta: Marketplace listing assets needed: 3 screenshots, 30s demo video, short blurb (1-2 lines). Sophie please produce.
Sophie: will export screenshots and 720p mp4. ETA 3 hours.
Ethan: note: telemetry endpoint must exclude PII. sending only metrics and usage counters with hashed identifiers. ops will add consent flag in manifest.
Marta: fine. include privacy excerpt: "Aggregated usage metrics only, no content or PII transmitted."
Lina: timeline: today = manifest + legal drafts + package upload. tomorrow = QA smoke tests + assets + SKU mapping finalization. aim to submit publisher portal validation by EOD tomorrow.
Raj: will post SKU mapping CSV by 1600 PT.
Sophie: upload complete :white_check_mark: s3://redwood-mkp-staging-1799/redwood-inference-2026.tar.gz
Ethan: running validation script now: `./scripts/marketplace_validate.sh redwood-inference-2026.tar.gz`
Ethan: validation output: PASS manifest schema, PASS artifact URIs, WARN missing localized EULA: fr-FR, de-DE.
Marta: acknowledged. I'll prepare fr/de localized EULA drafts and share links here.
Lina: thanks everyone. if blockers appear ping @here or call me. closing Day-0 checklist in 30m unless issues. :thumbsup:
